title: Gusinzira Birenze Igihe
intro: Tekereza igihe ukuri kwacecetswe maze abizera bagahigwa. Itsinda rito ryahisemo kwisubiraho aho kwitanga, rigashaka ubuhungiro ahantu hadasanzwe - ahantu hazaba ahantu ho kuruhukira mu binyejana byinshi bitabarika. Ubwo amaherezo bakangukaga, isi yari yarahindutse ibakikije. Ni bande abo bantu basinziriye?
clues: Twari abakiri bato batuye mu mujyi wa kera.
Umuryango wacu wasabye ko dusengera hamwe na bo, ariko twarabyanze.
Twahunze umujyi dushaka ubuhungiro bw'abarwanyaga imyizerere yacu.
Umugenzi w’indahemuka w’amaguru ane yagumye ku muryango w’aho twari twihishe.
Imana yaduteye gusinzira imyaka magana atatu n'icyenda.
Ubwo twakangukaga, umujyi wacu wahoze utotezwa wari waremeye.
